remoteKeyboardAndroid.label: v1.0.2-260920
changelog: [improvement] Settings picks Bluetooth or Helper, and Connect stays on that path
[improvement] Helper connection status shows the computer name without a Helper prefix
[bugfix] AmL One GET finds the Android APK
[bugfix] AmL One GET installs the Windows, Ubuntu, and Mac helpers from a zip
[bugfix] Helper finds the phone advertised as AOW Keyboard
[bugfix] Helper types keys and moves the mouse after it finds the phone
[bugfix] Connection status wraps on a normal-width phone instead of trimming with an ellipsis
